name: Lateral lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Take a big step out to the side with one foot.
Sit your hips back and down over that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to the middle, then switch sides.
cue: Step wide, sit back over the leg
mistakes: Letting the bent knee cave inward.
Lifting the heel of the bent leg.
